overview_description.description:
In 2007, Yubico was founded with the goal of creating a more secure and user-friendly way to authenticate digital identities. Yubico developed the YubiKey, a small USB device that provides strong two-factor authentication, and set out to make it widely available to consumers and businesses.

The YubiKey is designed to be highly secure and easy to use, providing an additional layer of protection for user accounts and sensitive data. By requiring both a physical device and a password or biometric factor, the YubiKey helps to prevent unauthorized access and identity theft. It is widely compatible with a variety of platforms and services, including Google, Microsoft, Facebook, and Dropbox, and can be used for a variety of authentication methods, including one-time passcodes, public-key encryption, and passwordless login.

Yubico has since grown into a global leader in authentication and security, with offices and customers around the world. The company has expanded its product line to include a range of hardware and software solutions, including the YubiHSM, YubiEnterprise Services, and the YubiCloud authentication-as-a-service platform. Yubico's products are used by a wide range of industries, including healthcare, finance, government, and technology, and the company continues to innovate and develop new solutions for the rapidly evolving digital security landscape.

product.name: YubiKey
product.description: A hardware security key for phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication and passwordless access to online accounts, applications, computers, mobile devices, and enterprise systems.

product.name: YubiKey 5 Series
product.description: A multifunction hardware security key series supporting passkeys, FIDO2/WebAuthn, smart-card authentication, one-time passwords, and other authentication protocols.

product.name: YubiKey 5 FIPS Series
product.description: A hardware security key series for phishing-resistant MFA, passkeys, and certificate-based authentication in regulated and high-assurance environments.

product.name: Security Key Series
product.description: A hardware security key focused on FIDO2 and U2F authentication for phishing-resistant sign-in to compatible online services and applications.

product.name: YubiKey Bio Series
product.description: A biometric hardware security key that uses fingerprint verification with FIDO2/WebAuthn authentication for passwordless and multi-factor sign-in.

product.name: YubiHSM 2 & YubiHSM 2 FIPS
product.description: A hardware security module for protecting cryptographic keys and performing secure cryptographic operations in servers, applications, and infrastructure.
